subject: Algebra
title: Keep It Balanced
subtitle: Solving 2x + 3 = 11
headline: Whatever you do to one side, do to the _other_.
quote: Letters in math make no sense to me.
question: What value of x keeps both sides equal?

diagram.move: Take 3 off both pans, then halve both pans.

comparison.think: The letter is the hard part.
comparison.math: x is just the {unknown weight}: x = 4.

takeaways: An equation is a balanced scale.
Equal moves on both sides keep it true.

takeaways.text: Checking your answer is part of solving.

philosophy: See the pattern. Change the form. *Keep the value.*
